lines.text: Many learners say: I can to swim.

native.tip: بعد can لا نضع to: “I can swim.” وليس “I can to swim.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “I can to swim.” 😅 بعد can لا نضع to، فالجملة الصحيحة “I can swim.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “speak”. بعد can لا نضع to. اختبار مجاني هنا: {link}

en.hook: Do you say “I can to swim”?
en.tip: After can we do not put to: “I can swim.” not “I can to swim.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “I can to swim.” 😅 After can we do not put to, so the right sentence is “I can swim.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
